Two things. A Course of 26 videos that teaches you how to protect every part of your work on paper, and a library of 20 ready agreements covering every person you will ever deal with in this business. Clients, contractors, vendors, the freelancers you hire, and your own team. Each agreement comes with the blanks marked out for you and 55 clean Canva layouts (5 each contract) so you can send it out looking like a real brand.

Yes. It starts from nothing and assumes you know no law at all. The whole 2nd module is the legal side in plain language, no jargon thrown at you, so you know exactly what is real and what is just a formality everybody stresses about for no reason. It works whether this is your 1st project or your 100th.

This is the most asked question, and it gets a full module of its own. A large part of our Industry is unorganised, and your kadia or your local one man contractor is genuinely never going to sign a printed document. That is normal, and anybody who tells you otherwise has never run a site in this country. So the Course gives you a whole ladder instead:
- A method for the organised people.
- A method for the semi organised ones.
- A method that never uses the word contract.

You are protected regardless of who is standing in front of you, be it a completely unorganized person or an organized person. The rule the whole Course stands on is that it is never ZERO. The method changes completely depending on who is in front of you. It is just never nothing.

The contracts are lawyer verified and built for Indian practice. And the stamp paper, notary, registration related doubts gets cleared completely in the Course. Your design contract is valid and binding without stamp paper. Stamping is a small flat state fee, nothing else, and it is what makes a contract ready to be used in court, not what makes it real. Your service agreements do not need to be registered, and notarisation is optional, never required.

No. It runs on free tools only. The contracts open in Notion, the Designed layouts are in Canva, and the 3 trackers are Notion, all on Free plans.

Yes, and the Course is very specific about this. You never put a 20 page contract in front of a ₹40,000 job, that just frightens a perfectly good client away. You right size the paper to the job, and you are taught exactly how to judge that, by the money, the risk, and how long the relationship will last.

Straight after payment. You are taken to your dashboard with everything inside it, and you also get an order confirmation email with your access within 5 to 10 minutes. Check spam if you do not see it. Log in with the email or phone number you paid with and start.
